ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jun-03-2008 Reset To Jun-12-08 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioner Jackie Noreen Taylor was present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the minor Sharale Adaria Do'nata Taylor, who was also present at today's hearing.
Petitioner was placed under oath and examined. Proof of Publication in the file.

Petitioner was unable to provide the Court with the requisite proof of service indicating that the minor's father was provided with notice of today's hearing.

Good cause appearing, the Order to Show Cause for Change of Name of the minor is continued to June 12, 2008 @ 9:00 a.m. in Department 218. No further publication is required.

Reissued Order to Show Cause for Change of Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
